title: T-C：因子层补全的预注册检验

protocol.question: Choose the completion weight w and decide the regime-dependent covariance on validation; score the completion of unstated factors once on the test; gate: where the model cannot infer, it stays near unconditional.
protocol.implementation: scenariolab.qmodel.factor_checks.tc(Q, P, seed, scoring='exact'), called once by this runner on the monthly panel P and the quarterly panel Q; qmodel.json's stored T_C is not read for the decision

validation.refits: yearly, each January on data to the previous December (fit at (year-1)Q4, anchors fitted to the train end, §5.5)

protocol.mode: step mode (H = 1): the Gaussian conditional moments of the quarter given the origin's state and the stated fields (factors.conditional_moments)
protocol.scoring_text: every x field is a monotone transform of one linear combination of the stacked quarter, so its predictive mean, CRPS and 80% interval are computed exactly (factor_checks.step_moments: Gaussian closed forms, Gauss-Hermite for the bounded scales, censored-normal means at the floors, the pinball integral on a fixed normal-quantile grid); no Monte Carlo, so the conditional and unconditional sets differ only by the statements and every gate cell's MC standard error is 0
protocol.information: the origin's state from data published by its start only (factors.initial_state 'published', §3.2: the previous quarter's CPI, IP, unemployment, NIPA, Z.1, profits and the budget are imputed from the joint distribution given what was published)

patterns.a: a random 50% of the factor layer's x fields stated (rng([seed, year, quarter]))
patterns.b: only the E0 and E0p fields stated (narrative-like)
patterns.c: only the financial-conditions fields stated (card fc_role required_one or optional)

protocol.stated_values: the realized values, saturated as §3.5 writes it (the gap to the conditional mean at +-4 training sd, factors.saturation); d_ff is not stated in zero-bound quarters (the shadow rate is not observed at the floor)
protocol.metrics: per unstated field: completion R² against the model's unconditional (state-only) prediction, CRPS, 80% coverage (the exact 10-90% interval)
protocol.selection_w: w* = argmin over the grid of the mean CRPS relative to the unconditional CRPS, pattern (b), E1 / E1c / E2 fields, pooled covariance, validation origins

regime_cov.adopt_if: at w*, pattern (b): the E1-class mean relative CRPS in ZLB quarters is lower with the regime covariance than without, and its change in every other cell (pattern a, c, and b outside the ZLB; ZLB and normal quarters) is at most +0.01

protocol.gate: pattern (b) on the test: every E1-class field's completion R² >= -0.02 (exact; MC se 0)
protocol.application: This run records T-C's selection and gate. It does not change config_q.COMPLETION_W or REGIME_COV: path mode (qmodel.factors.simulate) would follow them while step mode (qmodel.rollout.Stepper) implements neither, so switching them breaks the step / path consistency of §3.7. The lead decides after the run.
supersedes_because: the frozen record's gate was decided by Monte Carlo noise: R² on means of 1,000 draws per origin with independent conditional and unconditional streams (re-scored on 8 draw seeds the gate passed in 3; the probability that the linear E1 satellites pass was about 0.13)
its initial states used the previous quarter's realized values, which the panel's own release lags mark as unpublished at the origin (38 of 52 stacked variables at a January origin)
its saturation band was ±4 sd of a 400-path Gaussian prior with the t-weighted Sigma, narrower than §3.5's ±4 training sd
disclosure: Seen before this record was frozen: the frozen record's run (2026-11-02_TC.json: w* 0.25, regime covariance not adopted, gate failed with d_tp10 at -0.029) and the statistics review's re-scoring of its test block: exact Gaussian means under the frozen information gave d_tp10 -0.0206 and d_bdlev -0.0304 (both below -0.02); hiding only the 18 unpublished satellites gave d_tp10 -0.0048, d_cpbill 0.0043, d_hpi 0.0222. This record's combination (exact scoring, every unpublished value imputed, §3.5 saturation) had not been run on the test before it was frozen; its plumbing was checked on validation origins only.
The test decade 2015-26 has been seen by earlier rounds (§4.2 disclosure).

Nothing else changed: data files, seed, patterns, w grid, selection and regime rules and the gate are the frozen record's. The factor layer's code changed in the same fix round (the bootstrap pool is centred, which step-mode Gaussian scoring does not use; the rarity statistic; the QTable reader).
interpretations: 'E1 field' in the gate = card endogeneity class E1 (financial markets); the w selection uses E1, E1c and E2 (the classes §3.5 shrinks).
Completion is scored in step mode (one quarter), as the implementation does.
